body.name: Candidate mass-weighted grouped moment-reconstruction blueprint
body.construction: This node is a candidate blueprint, not a constructed estimator.  A complete instantiation would have to specify, as deterministic functions of \(n\), \(d\), and \(\epsilon\), the sample split, pilot mass shells and effect intervals, degree \(K\), finite grid, joint four-cell factorial statistics, exact covariance bound, feasibility tolerances, nonnegative Hausdorff-moment program, aggregation and mass normalization, Rao--Blackwellization rule, and deterministic fallback.  Only after those choices are given and measurability, feasibility, and risk are proved does the resulting sample map define \(\widehat G_{\mathrm{grp}}\in\mathcal P([-1,1])\).
